svg.title: Dark Green Panel
Dark Green Panel
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry and interpretive screen colours. Six-sided indented support traced by eye from the oblique museum photograph; depth omitted and contour approximate. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of green; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://collection.themodern.org/objects/1781/dark-green-panel; inspected2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation, not a facsimile.

svg.title: Blue Curve
Blue Curve
svg.desc: Interpretive study from a visually inspected primary gallery photograph. Approximate geometry and interpretive palette. Photograph perspective, shadows and texture omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of blue; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-recent-paintings-10-1994/lightbox/works/blue-curve-1994-2480; inspected 2026-10-27. This editable vector is a study, not a facsimile.

svg.title: Red on Red
Red on Red
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry, interpretive colours. Two equal red panels offset diagonally. Thin darker seam is a viewing guide for overlap, not an additional paint colour. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red including an unpublished contributor photograph; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.sfmoma.org/artwork/FC.713/; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.
